Description

  

    
Impact

We'd updated URL Validation logic on user input to provide sanitation on user inputted URLs for clouddriver.  However, we missed that Java URL objects do not correctly handle underscores on parsing.  This led to a bypass of the previous CVE (CVE-2025-61916) through the use of carefully crafted URLs.  Note, we found this not just in that CVE, but in the existing URL validations in Orca fromUrl expression handling.  This CVE impacts BOTH artifacts as a result.

Patches

This has been merged and will be available in versions 2025.4.2, 2025.3.1, 2025.2.4 and 2026.1.0.

Workarounds

You can disable the various artifacts on this system to work around these limits.

References

GHSA-vrjc-q2fh-6x9h Original advisory is available here.
